entities.summary: Faruq al-Qaddumi or Farouk al-Kaddoumi, also known by the kunya Abu al-Lutf, was a Palestinian politician who served as the Secretary-General of Fatah until 2009 and Chairman of Fatah's central committee and the Palestine Liberation Organization's political department, operating from Tunisia, between 2004 and 2009.
